items.prompt: A learner replaces grid[n-1-column][row] with grid[column][row]. On [[a,b],[c,d]], which output exposes the missing clockwise reversal?

options.why: That replacement transposes. The required clockwise rows are c a / d b.
Those are the required clockwise rows, not the output of the replacement expression.
That is a half turn, not the transpose performed by the replacement.
The replacement exchanges row and column, so it is not the identity on these distinct tokens.
